findings.one_line: The negative-cycle criterion characterizes P_c^zeta minus {0_c}, not P_c^zeta: if every component box is {0}, the branch is nonempty but the log system has the inserted negative self-cycle.
For optimization on F_zeta(H,t), Eq. (20) omits the pin multiplier: stationarity/value require G_zeta^T y + H^T lambda = c and g_zeta^T y + lambda^T(Hs-t) = c^T b*.
On the reproduced stable C1-cell finite-difference argument, epsilon_n to 0 suffices; the stated sqrt(n) epsilon_n to infinity restriction is unused (and is likewise unused by the safe-cell proof).
